RimHex.HexStarChallengeDef030.label: Find your range
RimHex.HexStarChallengeDef030.description: Threat: A suppressor protects a shooter that fires into a locked lane. Answer: Interrupt suppression with actual damage or control, kill the suppressor, or use cover. Reward: The shooter loses protection and its current charge, taking 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Cost: Ignoring suppression retains up to 20% shooter defense and safe fire. Arrangement: Baited pursuit; forward lock lanes. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
